title: Game News Round-Up
summary: Daily curated games-industry news digest for 9 November 2026.

items.title: Sony’s free-to-play mobile **Ratchet & Clank** multiplayer shooter (Ratchet and Clank: Ranger Rumble) has been cancelled
bullets: Ranger Rumble was initially announced in November 2025 and was described as ” fast-paced multiplayer platformer arena shooter”, published by PlayStation and developed by Oh BiBi in partnership with Insomniac.

The game soft-launched that month with an initial release in the Philippines and Indonesia, before rolling out to other regions in the following months including Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark, France, Canada and the UK.
Will be delisted from stores November 21st and the servers will shut down May 1st 2027

**Sega** Q2 Financial Results
bullets: Net sales: ¥212.5 billion ($1.3 billion), up 5.6% year-on-year

Operating income: ¥14.2 billion ($89.7 million), up 42% year-on-year
